title: Presentation Spec Generalization
description: Align @semio-tech/framework-presentation with the spec: introduce Slide (arrangement + optional transition), generalize Morph with auto-derived bridge slides, simplify Split to tiles only, remove bespoke column/ghost/morphTarget machinery, update renderer and 33.projektetage deck.
summary: Fixed Bauteilarten→Bauteilbeschriftungen figure morph: dormant column crop anchors were hidden on the resting focus slide so reveal.js only faded tiles while morphing. Added Arrangement.settleAfterMorphFrom plus renderer settled-state sync—after catalogue→focus tile morph completes, tiles hide and column crop figures show as morph sources that directly auto-animate into text labels (no bridge slide). Tests: core 33, renderer 20, deck 6 passing.
